title: crm.product.products-created, payload v1
description: The requested products now exist in product_db as PNDG, with ids and amounts assigned. Produced by product-service inside the SAME transaction that writes prod/prod_char_val (ADR-015 §5, ADR-017 §8.1). Destination: crm.product.evt.products-created.v1. PNDG and not ACTV deliberately: this says the products were created, not that the sale completed — confirmation (ADR-015 §5.6) and the account involvement that is the actual commit point (ADR-013 §8) are separate steps, and one 'sale done' event covering all three would be a lie for the window between them.

saleOperationId.description: The operation this creation belongs to — the same value as the order's Idempotency-Key and the envelope's sagaId, which is what makes the whole sale traceable under ONE id.

mainProductId.description: The INTERNET product; the others hang off it as children. Derived from the service type, never declared by the caller (ADR-015 §5.3).

totalAmount.description: AC-SALE-01-12 Total Amount, derived as the sum of the item price snapshots so one arithmetic definition exists in one place.

amount.description: The offer's price AT CREATION TIME. Published precisely so a consumer can freeze it: reading the catalog price back later would silently rewrite the history of a past order whenever a price changes (ADR-016 §2.4).

main.description: True for exactly one item — the INTERNET product that carries the service address.
